import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["rate_feed"].copy()

    # Reproduce cursor order: ORDER BY account_id, obs_date, obs_seq
    df = df.sort_values(
        ["account_id", "obs_date", "obs_seq"],
        kind="mergesort"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Forward-fill rate within each account (carry never crosses accounts)
    df["rate_filled"] = df.groupby("account_id")["rate"].ffill()

    # was_carried = 1 only when original rate was NULL but a prior rate
    # existed within the same account (ffill produced a non-null value)
    df["was_carried"] = (
        df["rate"].isna() & df["rate_filled"].notna()
    ).astype("int64")

    result = df[["account_id", "obs_seq", "obs_date", "rate_filled", "was_carried"]]

    return {"rate_filled": result}
